message.reasoning_content:
We need to read the fact: employee Gao used his position installing medical software to extort bribe from software installer Ma. Hospital paid Ma 267,200 yuan for software engineering, Ma transferred 83,292 yuan to Gao via bank. So Gao accepted bribe. The crime is "受贿" (accepting bribes) or "行贿" (giving bribe) but the defendant is Gao, who accepted. So the crime is "受贿罪". Also possibly "贿赂罪"? In Chinese criminal law, "受贿罪" is the specific. Also "索贿" is extortion of bribe? Actually "索贿" is requesting bribe, which is also a crime: "索贿罪" (extorting bribes). Under Chinese law, there is "受贿罪" (accepting bribes) and "行贿罪" (giving bribes). "索贿罪" is also a crime: "索贿罪" (extorting bribes). The fact says Gao "利用其负责安装医院的医疗软件工作之便，向办公软件安装人员马某索贿". So he requested a bribe. So the crime is "索贿罪". Also he accepted the bribe, which is "受贿罪". Usually both can be charged. The question: "只写这部分事实直接支持的罪名". The fact includes both requesting and receiving. So both crimes are supported. So answer: [罪名]索贿罪;受贿罪<eoa>

Check format: need Chinese characters. Use "索贿罪;受贿罪". Ensure no extra spaces.
